## Round 1: initial

Source file: [`prompt.md`](../../config/prompts/threejs/cyberpunk-hovercar-racing-v1/prompt.md)

```text
Create a complete, playable 3D racing game in a single HTML file using Three.js.
Game: Futuristic hovercar racing on a neon cyberpunk track. 3 laps. 3 AI opponents. Boost pads. Speedometer. Lap counter. Position tracker.
Controls: W/Up to accelerate, S/Down to brake, A/D or Left/Right to steer.
Visuals: Neon cyberpunk aesthetic. Glowing track edges. Particle effects for speed and boost. Dark skybox with city lights.
AI: 3 opponents with different colors that follow the track and react to the player.
Game States: Start screen → Active race → Race complete (shows position and lap times).
Tech: Single HTML file. Three.js from CDN. No external assets. 60fps. Keyboard only. Responsive viewport.
Build a functional, polished racing game that works immediately when opened.
```
